mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best AEO strategy for my specific pest control services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the best AEO strategy involves understanding your target audience's most common questions and pain points related to pests. Start by analyzing your current website's search queries, conducting thorough keyword research to identify 'question keywords,' and reviewing competitor's content that already ranks for answers. Prioritize creating comprehensive, authoritative content for your most profitable services (e.g., termite control, rodent removal). Regularly monitor performance and adapt your strategy based on which content generates the most answer engine visibility and customer engagement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO strategy by understanding your audience's pest questions, researching 'question keywords,' analyzing competitors, and prioritizing content for your main services.
